status: DRAFT PROPOSAL, NOT REGISTERED, NOT APPROVED. No approval entry exists, the research budget is unchanged (N 45/52), no market evaluation is authorised. It becomes a registration only by a separate owner approval and a freeze commit made before any stage-1 market statistic is read.
question: Does MAX3 (S = -MAX3, 28-day window) carry predictive and economic value beyond simple low-volatility selection? (L1 found IC 0.092 / 0.117 but S has a mean daily rank correlation of -0.913 with trailing volatility; L2 was confounded by terminal V3 shutdown.)
ladder: research diagnostic on top of L1/L2 results; never produces an operational L2/L3 pass
design: two stages, fixed sequence (gatekeeping): stage 1 signal level (high power, cheap); stage 2 research-only economic comparison, executed only for the horizons that pass stage 1

family.definition: the registered H1 signal (S = -MAX3, 28 days) tested for incremental value after controlling for volatility; horizons as in H1
family.free_parameters_note: none: the volatility measure is the standard deviation of the 28 daily returns (the window of MAX3), fixed; no other window or measure is tried

stage1_signal_level.universe_and_returns: identical to the L1 registration (PIT 5M universe, valid-S members, open-to-open returns over h days, last-observed-close exit rule, panel 2020-11-01..2025-06-29, signal dates 2021-01-01..last-(1+h), holdout never read)
stage1_signal_level.statistic: mean over signal days of the daily cross-sectional PARTIAL rank correlation of S with the h-day forward return controlling for the volatility rank V: rho(S,R|V) = (r_SR - r_SV*r_VR) / sqrt((1-r_SV^2)(1-r_VR^2)), all Spearman; V = -std of the 28 daily returns converted to cross-sectional ranks; minimum 20 assets per day
stage1_signal_level.inference: one-sided normal approximation of mean/HAC standard error, Newey-West lag 2h (14, 56); circular block-bootstrap check (block max(lag,2), 999 draws, seed 20261201 + h); two-sided 95 % CI and one-sided 95 % bounds reported
stage1_signal_level.multiple_testing: Holm across the 2 horizons (family-wise one-sided alpha 0.05); programme-wide Bonferroni over the post-registration N reported, non-gating

min_effect.rule: partial IC_h >= 0.003522504892367907 * sqrt(h) (0.0093 for h = 7, 0.0186 for h = 28): the S9 break-even IC scaled as in the L1 registration
min_effect.origin: S9 break-even daily IC 0.0035 (turnover 12, cost 0.15 %, margin 2) = about 3.6 % per year gross active return

stage1_signal_level.stability: partial IC > 0 in both sub-periods 2021-01..2022-12 and 2023-01..2025-06-29

negative_control_surrogates.purpose: size of the procedure on the real data when the signal is a pure volatility proxy
negative_control_surrogates.construction: 200 surrogate signals per horizon: S* = 0.913 * z(-volatility rank) + sqrt(1-0.913^2) * AR(1) noise (persistence 0.95), independent of returns; seed 20261202
negative_control_surrogates.rule: the fraction of surrogates rejected at one-sided 5 % must be <= 0.10, otherwise stage 1 is INCONCLUSIVE (mis-sized test)

stage1_signal_level.integrity: independent pandas re-implementation of the partial IC series must match within 1e-9 (as V1 in M4); data gates as in L1 (>= 1000 valid days, mean assets >= 30, coverage >= 0.80)

outcomes_per_horizon.ESTABLISHED: Holm p <= 0.05 AND partial IC >= min effect AND stable AND surrogate size <= 0.10 AND integrity ok
outcomes_per_horizon.REFUTED: one-sided 95 % upper bound of the partial IC < min effect (conclusive that any incremental effect is below the economic threshold)
outcomes_per_horizon.INCONCLUSIVE: surrogate size > 0.10 or an integrity gate fails

descriptive_not_gating: double sort: volatility terciles x MAX3 terciles, mean next-period return spread of the least-lottery-like tercile minus the most lottery-like, averaged over volatility terciles (HAC CI)
partial IC by sub-period and by BTC regime

stage2_economic_research_only.executed_only_if: stage 1 outcome is ESTABLISHED for at least one horizon; only those horizons are evaluated; the owner approves the stage-2 run by a separate written instruction unless the owner pre-authorises it in the approval of this proposal
stage2_economic_research_only.label: RESEARCH-ONLY UNPROTECTED EVALUATION. It never qualifies as an operational L2 pass, never implies L3, paper or live trading, and never changes the M4 L2 NO-GO.

arms.max3: the M4 MAX3 portfolio (top quintile of S, K = max(5, ceil(0.2 n)), equal notional, rebalance every h days from 2021-01-02, signal of day D-1 at 01:00 UTC on day D)
arms.low_volatility: the pure low-volatility baseline: the same eligible set, K, tie-breaking, schedule, execution and costs, ranked by the lowest 28-day realised volatility (the M4 volatility score)

stage2_economic_research_only.execution_identical_for_all_arms: frozen Stage 0 engine, hourly candles, fees 0.10 % + slippage 0.05 % (normal) and 0.20 % + 0.10 % (double), 1 h latency, 10 % participation cap with partial fills, min notional 5, wallet 10,000 USDT
stage2_economic_research_only.protection: engine circuit breaker OFF and Risk Management V3 NOT acting in the unprotected arms, so a terminal shutdown cannot confound the comparison; Risk Management V3 (zero recovery) is run as a SHADOW (state machine stepped on each arm's hourly equity, reporting only: states, transitions, would-be shutdown time) and is never fed back into orders

comparators.exposure_matched: CAUSAL: BTC/cash with the invested fraction of the MAX3 arm over the previous 28 days (known at the rebalance day), updated at each rebalance; no ex-post calibration
comparators.causally_risk_matched: CAUSAL: at each rebalance day t the weight of BTC (rest cash) is w_t = min(1, sigma_arm,t / sigma_btc,t) with both volatilities estimated from the previous 28 daily returns strictly before t; scaling costs charged on the weight change
comparators.volatility_matched_low_volatility: CAUSAL (the primary comparator): the low-volatility arm scaled at each rebalance day by w_t = min(1, sigma_max3,t / sigma_lowvol,t) with trailing 28-day volatilities known at t, remainder in cash; scaling costs charged on the weight change

stage2_economic_research_only.primary_test: paired daily net return difference MAX3 arm minus the volatility-matched low-volatility arm, normal costs, one-sided HAC (lag 10); Holm across the horizons that reach stage 2
stage2_economic_research_only.min_economic_effect: net annualised difference >= 3.6 % per year (the S9 break-even gross active return at margin 2), with a positive one-sided 95 % lower bound under normal costs and a non-negative point estimate under double costs
stage2_economic_research_only.uncertainty: HAC standard error, 95 % CI, stationary block bootstrap (block 20 days, 999 draws, seed 20261203) of the annualised difference
stage2_economic_research_only.also_reported: net returns, CAGR, Sharpe, Sortino, max drawdown, Calmar, turnover, cost drag, exposure; alpha of the MAX3 arm on the low-volatility arm and on BTC (HAC); shadow-V3 states

outcomes.ESTABLISHED: primary test p <= 0.05 AND effect >= 3.6 %/yr (normal) AND >= 0 (double)
outcomes.REFUTED: one-sided 95 % upper bound of the annualised difference < 3.6 %/yr
outcomes.INCONCLUSIVE: otherwise (expected to be common: the paired test can detect only an annualised information ratio of about 1.17 on 4.5 years)

decision_tree.D1: stage 1 NOT_ESTABLISHED or REFUTED at both horizons -> ABANDON H1: MAX3 shows no incremental predictive value beyond volatility; stage 2 is not run; the L1 PASS is recorded as 'volatility proxy'
decision_tree.D2: stage 1 ESTABLISHED at >= 1 horizon -> run stage 2 for those horizons
decision_tree.D3: stage 2 ESTABLISHED -> the owner may be offered a SEPARATE hypothesis H1b (volatility-neutral MAX3 selection inside a causally volatility-targeted portfolio), with its own registration and budget; nothing is implied
decision_tree.D4: stage 2 REFUTED -> abandon H1 (incremental effect real at most below the economic threshold)
decision_tree.D5: stage 2 INCONCLUSIVE -> H1 is NOT carried forward on economics; record 'incremental signal present, economic value unproven'; only if the point estimate is >= the minimum effect may H1b be proposed, labelled underpowered
decision_tree.D6: independently of H1: a separate volatility-targeted low-volatility hypothesis (plain low-volatility selection with causal exposure scaling) is a NEW family needing its own pre-registration, parameters fixed a priori from the 20 % drawdown limit, and budget; it is not part of this proposal
decision_tree.D7: any integrity failure, guard failure or budget exceedance -> stop and report; no rerun

stopping_rules: stage 2 is never run when stage 1 fails (saves the replay allowance)
each stage is executed once; no fix-and-rerun after results are seen; infrastructure defects are fixed before the run on synthetic data
no horizon, window, volatility measure, quantile, comparator or cost level is added after registration
N may not exceed the recorded post-registration value; any request for more stops the work and asks the owner

ledger_today.h1_diagnostic_replays: 1 of 1 consumed (M4; added 0 configurations, so N did not change)

recommended_option_R.description: register one new family h1_vol_control with 2 configurations (VC-h7, VC-h28); stage 1 is its single market run; stage 2 is its single approved diagnostic replay (protocol V2 section 8)
recommended_option_R.caps_check: configurations 2 <= 3; market runs 1 <= 1; diagnostic replays 1 <= 1; N 47 <= 52: no cap is exceeded

conservative_option_C.description: charge the stage-2 horizon comparisons as additional trials (4 trials)
conservative_option_C.requires: an owner exception to max_configurations_per_family (4 > 3) or a third family slot (families 3 of 3)

remaining_after_R.note: enough for one further family of at most 3 configurations (N <= 50)

budget.multiplicity_note: under option R the stage-2 comparisons are not extra ledger trials but are inside the registered fixed-sequence procedure (stage 2 only after stage 1; Holm across horizons), so no multiplicity is hidden; option C is the stricter bookkeeping

guards_to_implement_after_approval: owner approval entry for the exact spec hash with scope 'M5 stage 1' (stage 2 needs its own approval or an explicit pre-authorisation)
family h1_vol_control registered in the research budget with N 47 before any result is read
stage 2 guard reads the stage-1 result file and the passing horizons
known_limitations: one history (2021-2025) and one venue; research-only licence
the volatility baseline is one fixed definition (28-day standard deviation); a different baseline could change the conclusion and is deliberately not searched
the partial IC removes only the rank-linear part of the volatility relation
portfolio-level tests have low power (annualised IR 1.17 detectable at 80 %)
surrogate nulls assume a persistence of 0.95 (an assumption)
stage 2 is research-only and unprotected by construction
